blocking_findings.contract_source: Authoritative Astra Plan Step 6 Verification and Current Step Boundary checks 3 and 5
blocking_findings.exact_requirement: Real subprocess fixture tests must prove delayed descendant writers are terminated before the helper returns and cannot write afterward.
blocking_findings.concrete_evidence: tests/test_factory_builder_process.py configures both descendant writes with delay="2" but waits only time.sleep(0.8) before asserting nonexistence. Fresh test durations were 1.24 seconds including the 0.4-second cancellation delay and 0.88 seconds for normal parent exit. A direct control run of the fixture produced exists_after_0_8s=false and exists_after_2_3s=true.
blocking_findings.observed_state: The tests pass even when a delayed child remains alive and writes at its scheduled time, so they do not discriminate successful containment from an escaped writer.
blocking_findings.expected_state: Each test must synchronize on descendant creation and assert target absence after the configured write deadline, or use an equivalent deterministic signal proving the descendant was terminated and remained unable to write.
blocking_findings.why_it_blocks_current_step: Delayed-writer containment is an explicit Step 6 release gate protecting downstream tests, snapshots, rollback, and review. The current packet lacks machine-verifiable evidence for that safety invariant.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Adjust both real fixture tests so their observation window extends deterministically beyond the child write deadline, preferably with shorter bounded delays and an armed/readiness signal; assert retained cancellation evidence as applicable. Rerun the exact scoped suite, regenerate candidate hashes and diff SHA-256, and request a fresh review.
